instructions: Template for bulk-generating news article content for injector.world. Read the fields and referenceData sections below, then fill the news array with your generated article objects (see the exact shape in fields). Save as .json and upload it on the News admin page. Uploaded articles are staged as drafts and only go live after an admin approves them. This file intentionally has no example rows, only schema and reference data.

slug.pattern: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, e.g. fda-approves-new-filler
slug.description: URL slug. Leave blank and one is generated automatically from the title. This is the unique key: re-uploading with the same slug later updates that article instead of creating a duplicate.

excerpt.description: Short summary for listing cards, under 300 characters. Leave blank and the title is used as a fallback.

body.description: The article body. Either one plain-text string (single paragraph) or an array of strings, one per paragraph, e.g. ["Paragraph one.", "Paragraph two."]. No markdown, no HTML.

category.description: Controls the category badge and filtering on the news index.

coverImageUrl.description: External image URL. Only used if no cover image is uploaded manually in admin afterward.

authorName.description: Exact author name from referenceData.validAuthorNames. Leave blank to use the default 'injector.world Editorial Team' author.

featured.description: Pin this article to the top of the news index.

notSupportedByBulkUpload: medicalReviewer, relatedService, publishedAt are not set by bulk upload (same as the old importer). Edit these manually in admin after the article is created if needed.
